description: Analysis code, figures and derived data products for the paper Where subducted water resides: seismic carriers, shallow storage and removal at mid-ocean ridges (Müller, Fichtner, Schiller, Mather, Dutkiewicz and Dixon, in preparation for Earth and Planetary Science Letters). The archive rebuilds every figure and supplementary table of the paper from the derived products in out/ without the tomography models or the plate model; README.md gives the layout, the inputs, the commands and the licences. Code under MIT; figures and derived data under CC BY 4.0; third-party data retain their source licences.
